# Compute Pearson correlations and p-values with pairwise deletion
def compute_corr(df, x, y):
    sub = df[[x, y]].dropna()
    r, p = stats.pearsonr(sub[x], sub[y])
    return r, p, len(sub)

results = []
for pair in [('digm','CALLY'), ('digm','CALLYlog10')]:
    ra_r, ra_p, ra_n = compute_corr(ra, *pair)
    nr_r, nr_p, nr_n = compute_corr(non_ra, *pair)
    diff = ra_r - nr_r
    results.append({
        'Variable Pair': f"{pair[0]}-{pair[1]}",
        'RA r': round(ra_r, 4),
        'RA p': round(ra_p, 4),
        'RA n': ra_n,
        'Non-RA r': round(nr_r, 4),
        'Non-RA p': round(nr_p, 4),
        'Non-RA n': nr_n,
        'Diff (RA - Non-RA)': round(diff, 4),
    })

out = pd.DataFrame(results)
print(out.to_string(index=False))
